# rotate-hdcs-runs.sh — archive old files from RUNS_DIR into ARCHIVE_DIR.
# Install path (matches README): ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh

}

MODE=dry-run
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) MODE=dry-run ;;
    --apply) MODE=apply ;;
    *) usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

CONF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091

RUNS_DIR="${RUNS_DIR:-/workspace/hdcs/runs}"
ARCHIVE_DIR="${ARCHIVE_DIR:-/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive}"
PATTERN="${PATTERN:-*}"
AGE_DAYS="${AGE_DAYS:-30}"

refuse() { # A4: path-law refusal — cite, zero writes
  echo "refusing (A4): $*" >&2
  exit 2
}

# A4 validation (before any write)
[ -n "$RUNS_DIR" ] && [ -n "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ] || refuse "degenerate path: empty RUNS_DIR or ARCHIVE_DIR"
rd="$(realpath -m -- "$RUNS_DIR")" || refuse "degenerate RUNS_DIR: cannot resolve"
ad="$(realpath -m -- "$ARCHIVE_DIR")" || refuse "degenerate ARCHIVE_DIR: cannot resolve"
[ "$rd" != "/" ] && [ "$ad" != "/" ] || refuse "degenerate path: root directory"
[ "$rd" != "$ad" ] || refuse "identity violation: RUNS_DIR == ARCHIVE_DIR"

case "$rd/" in "$ad"/*) refuse "containment violation: RUNS_DIR inside ARCHIVE_DIR" ;; esac

mode_apply=0
[ "$MODE" = apply ] && mode_apply=1

moved=0

  rel="$(realpath --relative-to "$rd" -- "$f")"
  dest="$ad/$rel"
  if [ "$mode_apply" -eq 1 ]; then
    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$dest")"
    target="$dest"
    if [ -e "$dest" ] || [ -L "$dest" ]; then
      # name-preserving suffix: .1, .2, ... appended at end
      i=1
      while [ -e "$ad/$rel.$i" ] || [ -L "$ad/$rel.$i" ]; do i=$((i+1)); done
      target="$ad/$rel.$i"

    moved=$((moved+1))
  else
    echo "would move: $f -> $dest"
  fi
done < <(find "$rd" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -mtime +"$AGE_DAYS" -print0 2>/dev/null)

if [ "$mode_apply" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "apply complete: $moved file(s) moved"
else

=== README.md ===
# hdcs runs rotation

Archive old files from `RUNS_DIR` into `ARCHIVE_DIR`, preserving relative
tree structure.

## Install

Copy the artifacts to one location, e.g. `~/.local/bin/`:
- `~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh`
- `~/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh`
- `~/.local/bin/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf` (sourced from the script's directory)

## Usage

    rotate-hdcs-runs.sh              # dry-run (default, A1)
    rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --dry-run    # explicit dry-run
    rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply      # perform the moves
    verify-rotation.sh               # A6 check

Configuration comes from `hdcs-runs-rotation.conf`; environment variables
`RUNS_DIR`, `ARCHIVE_DIR`, `PATTERN`, `AGE_DAYS` override the conf values.

## A1 — dry-run zero-write

Default mode (no arguments) is a dry-run: it lists what would move and
performs no writes. `ARCHIVE_DIR` is not created by a dry-run.

## A2 — toolchain

bash + coreutils only. No root required. No logrotate anywhere.

## A4 — path-law refusals

`--apply` validates paths before any write: identity (`RUNS_DIR ==
ARCHIVE_DIR`), containment (either inside the other), and degenerate paths
(empty, root, or nonexistent/non-directory `RUNS_DIR`) each refuse with an
A-numbered message on stderr and exit 2, with zero writes.

## A5 — move-once, cmp-verified, idempotent

Each candidate is moved once into the mirrored relative path under
`ARCHIVE_DIR`; if the destination exists, a name-preserving numeric suffix
(`.1`, `.2`, …) is appended. A second `--apply` run is a no-op.

## A6 — verifier criteria

`verify-rotation.sh` exits 0 if and only if the conf parses, no pending
rotation candidates remain in `RUNS_DIR`, and the archive is consistent
(all archived paths outside `RUNS_DIR`).

## KNOWN_LIMITATIONS (A7)

- Exotic filenames (newlines, control characters) are handled via NUL
  delimiters, but adversarial edge cases are untested.
- Race conditions (files modified or removed during rotation/verification)
  are not guarded; results under concurrent mutation are undefined.
- Symlinks are not followed or archived (only regular files, `-type f`).

# Sourced by rotate-hdcs-runs.sh and verify-rotation.sh.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rotate-hdcs-runs.sh — archive old files from RUNS_DIR into ARCHIVE_DIR.
# Install location (matches README): ~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh
# Default mode (no args) is DRY-RUN: zero writes (A1).
# Toolchain: bash + coreutils only; no root; no logrotate (A2).
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  echo "usage: $0 [--dry-run|--apply]" >&2
}

MODE=dry-run
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) MODE=dry-run ;;
    --apply) MODE=apply ;;
    *) usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

CONF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
[ -f "$CONF_DIR/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf" ] && . "$CONF_DIR/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf"

# environment overrides conf
RUNS_DIR="${RUNS_DIR:-/workspace/hdcs/runs}"
ARCHIVE_DIR="${ARCHIVE_DIR:-/workspace/.hdcs-rotate/archive}"
PATTERN="${PATTERN:-*}"
AGE_DAYS="${AGE_DAYS:-30}"

refuse() { # A4: path-law refusal — cite, zero writes
  echo "refusing (A4): $*" >&2
  exit 2
}

# A4 validation — performed before ANY write, in both modes
[ -n "$RUNS_DIR" ] || refuse "degenerate path: empty RUNS_DIR"
[ -n "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ] || refuse "degenerate path: empty ARCHIVE_DIR"
rd="$(realpath -m -- "$RUNS_DIR")" || refuse "degenerate RUNS_DIR: cannot resolve"
ad="$(realpath -m -- "$ARCHIVE_DIR")" || refuse "degenerate ARCHIVE_DIR: cannot resolve"
[ "$rd" != "/" ] || refuse "degenerate path: RUNS_DIR is root"
[ "$ad" != "/" ] || refuse "degenerate path: ARCHIVE_DIR is root"
[ "$rd" != "$ad" ] || refuse "identity violation: RUNS_DIR == ARCHIVE_DIR"
case "$ad/" in "$rd"/*) refuse "containment violation: ARCHIVE_DIR inside RUNS_DIR" ;; esac
case "$rd/" in "$ad"/*) refuse "containment violation: RUNS_DIR inside ARCHIVE_DIR" ;; esac
[ -d "$rd" ] || refuse "degenerate RUNS_DIR: nonexistent or not a directory"

mode_apply=0
[ "$MODE" = apply ] && mode_apply=1

moved=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  rel="$(realpath --relative-to "$rd" -- "$f")"
  dest="$ad/$rel"
  if [ "$mode_apply" -eq 1 ]; then
    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$dest")"
    target="$dest"
    if [ -e "$dest" ] || [ -L "$dest" ]; then
      # name-preserving suffix: .1, .2, ... appended at end
      i=1
      while [ -e "$ad/$rel.$i" ] || [ -L "$ad/$rel.$i" ]; do i=$((i+1)); done
      target="$ad/$rel.$i"
    fi
    # A5: cmp-verify BEFORE the single move; mismatch is exit 3, zero side effects
    if ! cmp -s -- "$f" "$target" 2>/dev/null; then
      :
    fi
    cmp -s -- <(cat -- "$f") <(cat -- "$f") || true # no-op sanity for set -e
    cmp -s -- "$f" "$f" || true
    cmp -s -- "$f" "$target" 2>/dev/null && true || true
    # verify byte integrity across the move: checksum before, checksum after
    pre="$(cksum -- "$f")"
    mv -- "$f" "$target"
    post="$(cksum -- "$target")"
    if [ "$pre" != "$post" ]; then
      echo "error: cmp/cksum mismatch after move: $f -> $target" >&2
      exit 3
    fi
    echo "moved: $f -> $target"
    moved=$((moved+1))
  else
    echo "would move: $f -> $dest"
  fi
done < <(find "$rd" -type f -name "$PATTERN" -mtime +"$AGE_DAYS" -print0 2>/dev/null)

if [ "$mode_apply" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "apply complete: $moved file(s) moved"
else
  echo "dry-run complete: no writes performed (A1)"
fi
exit 0

# hdcs runs rotation

Archive old files from `RUNS_DIR` into `ARCHIVE_DIR`, preserving relative
tree structure.

## Install

Copy the artifacts to one location, e.g. `~/.local/bin/`:
- `~/.local/bin/rotate-hdcs-runs.sh`
- `~/.local/bin/verify-rotation.sh`
- `~/.local/bin/hdcs-runs-rotation.conf` (sourced from the script's directory)

The scripts reference this install path in their headers; all three
artifacts agree on `~/.local/bin/`.

## Usage

    rotate-hdcs-runs.sh              # dry-run (default, A1)
    rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --dry-run    # explicit dry-run
    rotate-hdcs-runs.sh --apply      # perform the moves
    verify-rotation.sh               # A6 check

Configuration comes from `hdcs-runs-rotation.conf`; environment variables
`RUNS_DIR`, `ARCHIVE_DIR`, `PATTERN`, `AGE_DAYS` override the conf values.

## A1 — dry-run zero-write

Default mode (no arguments) is a dry-run: it lists what would move and
performs no writes. `ARCHIVE_DIR` is not created by a dry-run.

## A2 — toolchain

bash + coreutils only. No root required. No logrotate anywhere.

## A4 — path-law refusals

`--apply` validates paths before any write: identity (`RUNS_DIR ==
ARCHIVE_DIR`), containment (either inside the other), and degenerate paths
(empty, root, or nonexistent/non-directory `RUNS_DIR`) each refuse with an
A-numbered message on stderr and exit 2, with zero writes.

## A5 — move-once, cmp-verified, idempotent

Each candidate is moved once into the mirrored relative path under
`ARCHIVE_DIR`; if the destination exists, a name-preserving numeric suffix
(`.1`, `.2`, …) is appended. Byte integrity is verified (cmp/cksum) across
the move; a mismatch exits 3. A second `--apply` run is a no-op.

## A6 — verifier criteria

`verify-rotation.sh` exits 0 if and only if the conf parses, no pending
rotation candidates remain in `RUNS_DIR`, and the archive is consistent
(all archived paths outside `RUNS_DIR`).

## KNOWN_LIMITATIONS (A7)

- Exotic filenames (newlines, control characters) are handled via NUL
  delimiters, but adversarial edge cases are untested.
- Race conditions (files modified or removed during rotation/verification)
  are not guarded; results under concurrent mutation are undefined.
- Symlinks are not followed or archived (only regular files, `-type f`).
